title: The Anti-Google Privacy Stack
subtitle: Google uses your location to sell ads. We charge you money instead. That's the entire business model.
cardTitle: No Ads. No Data Selling. Ever.
cardDescription: Your data funds Google's $300B ad business. At Dawarich, your location data is the product you're buying — not the product we're selling.
cardDescription2: Don't trust anyone with your data? Run Dawarich on your own server. Your data never touches our infrastructure. We literally cannot see it.
cardDescription3: All data encrypted in transit (SSL/TLS) and at rest (LUKS). Stored in European data centers under strict GDPR regulations. You have full control over your data.
cardDescription4: Don't trust us? Read the code. OVER 9,000 GitHub stars. Thousands of developers have reviewed it. No hidden tracking. No surprises.
